referenceStandard.summary: Surgical resection with histopathology and molecular testing.

proofOfDiagnosis: Histopathology: astrocytoma, WHO grade 3 (WHO CNS 2021 classification).
IDH-mutant. 1p/19q not co-deleted. MGMT promoter methylated.
Location recorded by the treating team: left temporal lobe.
Pre-operative tumour volume from the collection's segmentation: about 35 mL.
Recorded by the collection as non-enhancing with T2/FLAIR hyperintensity.

referenceReport.technique: MRI brain: 3D T1 (MP2RAGE), 3D T1 post-contrast, 3D T2 (SPACE), 3D sagittal T2 FLAIR. Images are defaced. No diffusion, susceptibility or perfusion sequences are included in the published study.
